image_description: A close-up, high-angle shot of a sliced meatloaf resting in a crinkled aluminum foil pan. The loaf is oblong and has been cut into approximately six thick slices. It features a dark brown, textured interior consistent with ground meat, and is topped with a glossy, deep red glaze that appears caramelized and slightly charred in areas. The lighting creates strong specular highlights on the wet glaze.

The separation between slices is somewhat indistinct in the lower half, with the glaze appearing to 'smear' across the cuts slightly unnaturally, though this could be attributed to the moistness of the food.
